title: 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE---: the half-digit item in Lean, and the run to about 10^480 events
text: At about 10137 events the chain of 1RB0LE_1LC0RE_0RA0LD_1LA1LF_0LC0RE_1LE--- is followed by an item that is half a digit out of phase, 11 [Q] 00 11 [Q'] 01 [P]. A carry into it only adds 3 to Q, whatever follows Q. chain_event_open proves the chain law with such an open last item. With it, the run from blank tape is followed with proved laws through 500 stages, to about 10480 events, with no halt and 0 mismatches in 23,450 spot checks.
